title: Resonance near a doubly degenerate embedded eigenvalue
summary: This paper extends the study of resonance phenomenon initiated by the authors in~\cite{LS} to the case of doubly degenerate embedded eigenvalues (i.e. eigenvalue of multiplicity two). A fundamentally new concept is introduced to resolve the difficulties that arise in this study, beyond the methods of \cite{LS}. We apply a differential topological technique, namely the Morse Lemma, to study the present case.
